Family or coach buys the device

BallerCam (Baller, Inc. / BallerTV)Premium

Pasadena, California, USA · founded 2016 · active · ballercam.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Family or coach buys the devicePhone-basedNo Italian presence foundEvidence AUnder €500 to start

BallerCam is a $299 shell with a 180-degree lens, cooling fan and battery that turns an iPhone 13 Pro or newer into an AI camera that records, livestreams and clips youth basketball, soccer, futsal and volleyball games ballercam-01, ballercam-02.

For US and Canadian parents, team managers and club coaches who already own a recent iPhone and want automated filming and free livestreaming without a per-viewer or per-team subscription ballercam-01, ballercam-08. It is a family product first, and coaches use it because the footage and clips come free of per-seat fees ballercam-06.

BallerTV built BallerCam because eight years of streaming more than two million youth games with paid crews and fixed cameras taught it that the unit economics only work if the family owns the capture device, so it packaged its computer vision into a phone shell and launched it in July 2025 with Alex Morgan as investor and face ballercam-03, ballercam-04. It matters now because a $299 one-off device with a free 20-hour cloud tier undercuts every fixed camera with a mandatory subscription and pushes the category toward hardware-light, app-heavy products ballercam-02, ballercam-05. It tells you the youth capture market is splitting into two, a club tier that buys a dedicated camera and a family tier that buys an accessory for the phone it already carries, and that the second tier will be won on app reliability and storage economics ballercam-06, ballercam-07.

Price band $299 one-off device (list $349); cloud storage free for 20 hours, $99/yr for 100 hours, $199/yr for 250 hours ballercam-02

Italy New devices ship only to the US and Canada, the app works anywhere with an iPhone and connectivity, and the terms state the service is intended for users in the United States ballercam-08, ballercam-11.

The verdict

Look if You are a US or Canadian parent, team manager or small-club coach with an iPhone 13 Pro or newer and you want automated filming plus free livestreaming to family for a one-off $299 ballercam-01, ballercam-08. You should also look if you coach basketball, where the live scoring, clip creation and January 2026 advanced stats features are most developed ballercam-05, ballercam-13.

Skip if You are in Europe, since Baller only ships new devices to the US and Canada and its terms and privacy policy are written for US users with no GDPR section ballercam-08, ballercam-10, ballercam-11. You should also skip it if you need a full-pitch football recording tall enough for tactical analysis, since the camera sits on an 80-inch tripod and reviewers report tracking loss at greater heights ballercam-06, ballercam-07.

Watch-outs

  • The terms of service grant Baller, Inc. a perpetual, irrevocable, transferable, worldwide licence to use, modify, distribute and exploit user recordings without compensation, which is broader than most camera vendors ballercam-11.
  • The privacy policy states the service is not directed to children under 13 and contains no GDPR or EU rights section, so an EU club would carry the compliance work itself ballercam-10.
  • The App Store shows 4.9 stars from 505 ratings, and the critical reviews describe app freezes at setup, storage errors that block livestreams, misaligned clip markers across multiple devices and uploads taking one to two hours per game ballercam-06, ballercam-07.
  • Baller recommends 10 GB of free iPhone storage per hour of filming and a 5 Mbps upload for streaming, so a two-game day needs a phone with real headroom ballercam-09.
  • Filming is iPhone-only, iPhone 13 Pro or newer, with no Android filming app ballercam-09.
  • BallerTV's last disclosed venture round dates from September 2021, and no 2025 or 2026 financing has been announced beyond Alex Morgan's strategic investment ballercam-04, ballercam-14.

Products

  • BallerCam (camera). iPhone shell with 180-degree wide lens, cooling fan and swappable battery for AI-tracked recording and livestreaming, iPhone 13 Pro or newer ballercam-01.
  • BallerCam app (app). iOS app that runs on-device tracking, livestreaming, scoring, roster management, play tagging and clip creation, with an Apple Watch companion ballercam-06.
  • BallerCam cloud plans (platform). Browser viewer with 180-degree interactive angle picker, private links and cloud storage tiers of 20, 100 and 250 hours ballercam-05.
  • Tripods, adapters and carry case (add-on). 80-inch ultra-portable tripod, 15-foot outdoor tripod, model-specific iPhone adapters and a carry case sold as accessories ballercam-02.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
BallerCam targets family and team filming of youth basketball, volleyball, soccer and futsal, with American football, flag football and 7v7 supported through a dedicated guide and lacrosse and hockey listed as under consideration ballercam-01, ballercam-05, ballercam-12. The design centre is indoor court sports at 80-inch tripod height, which fits basketball well and full-size football pitches less well ballercam-01, ballercam-07. Coaches get scoring, roster and clip tools, and the January 2026 advanced stats release added player-attributed rebounds, assists, steals, blocks and fouls for basketball ballercam-13.
Capture quality
The device records 4K on the phone with 1080p downloads, and the livestream runs at 720p and auto-adjusts to connection speed ballercam-01. The optical path is a patent-pending ultra-wide lens giving a 180-degree sideline view, from which the app crops, pans and zooms in real time on the phone ballercam-03, ballercam-04. Reviewers describe clear video and good audio, and one review notes the desktop 180-degree viewer allows a coach to pick any angle after the game ballercam-06.
Automation accuracy
Tracking runs on-device with computer vision trained on BallerTV's archive of more than two million games ballercam-04. Positive reviews say the ball tracking does very well for basketball, while a two-star review reports the tracker losing the ball when the camera is mounted above the 80-inch tripod height ballercam-06, ballercam-07. Auto highlights are still listed as coming soon on the pricing page, and the current clip workflow relies on a scorer logging plays that the app then clips automatically ballercam-05, ballercam-13.
Multi-angle and stitching
BallerCam is a single-lens, single-phone product with no multi-camera stitching ballercam-01. Multiple phones can join a game for scoring and moment marking, and reviewers report time-sync drift between devices that misaligns moment markers ballercam-07. Not assessable further from public sources.
Latency and live readiness
Livestreaming is included on every plan at 720p with adaptive bitrate, viewers watch in a browser without an account, and the Pro plan adds RTMP out and a custom video logo ballercam-05, ballercam-12. Baller recommends a 5 Mbps upload and reviewers say a full signal is needed for a stable stream ballercam-07, ballercam-09. Latency figures are not published.
Reliability and resilience
The shell has a cooling fan powered by the swappable battery pack and ships with a sun shade, which Baller recommends for heat protection ballercam-01, ballercam-09. The app can record locally without internet and upload later ballercam-09. The reliability complaints in the App Store concern the software, with freezes at setup, storage errors and disappearing uploads reported by two-star reviewers against a 4.9 average from 505 ratings ballercam-06, ballercam-07.
Portability and install
The kit is a shell, phone adapter, battery, sun shade, back cover, cables and a sling bag, with an 80-inch ultra-portable tripod and a 15-foot outdoor tripod sold as accessories ballercam-01, ballercam-02. Setup is described by reviewers as very easy, and positioning guidance is mid-court or mid-field ballercam-06, ballercam-12. The phone adapter is model-specific and one is included per purchase ballercam-01.
Connectivity and bandwidth
Streaming needs a phone data or Wi-Fi connection of at least 5 Mbps upload, and record-only mode works offline ballercam-09. Reviewers report roughly 8 GB of footage per game and uploads that take one to two hours on ordinary connections ballercam-07. Baller's own guidance is 10 GB of free phone storage per hour filmed ballercam-09.
Workflow and UX
The filmer taps record or go live in the app, shares a private link, and family watch in a browser with no login ballercam-12. A scorer on a second device or an Apple Watch logs points and events that become clips and a live scoreboard ballercam-05, ballercam-07. Downloads at 1080p are available in-app immediately for the creator and on desktop after cloud upload, and team members get 720p immediately and 1080p after upload ballercam-15. The September 2026 app update added AI Plays feedback, live previews on the home screen and RSVP controls, which shows the roadmap is moving toward team management ballercam-06.
Analysis layer
Analysis is limited to scoring, play tagging, player attribution and a Game Breakdown view for basketball introduced in January 2026, with manual stat editing promised for spring 2026 ballercam-12, ballercam-13. There is no tactical drawing, no automatic event detection for football and no export to third-party analysis platforms documented ballercam-05. Auto-generated highlight reels remain on the roadmap ballercam-13.
Integrations
The Pro plan's RTMP output is the only documented integration and lets a club push the feed to YouTube or another platform ballercam-05. Footage can be stored on the phone, in BallerCam cloud or exported to third-party storage ballercam-12. No documented integrations with league platforms, analysis software or club management tools were found.
Distribution and OTT
Distribution is BallerCam's own browser viewer with private links and no viewer accounts, backed by the BallerTV platform heritage ballercam-04, ballercam-12. There is no paywall or pay-per-view for viewers, so the model is free sharing to family and friends ballercam-05. Pro-plan RTMP allows onward distribution to a third-party OTT service ballercam-05.
Data access and ownership
Users keep copyright in their recordings, but the terms grant Baller, Inc. a perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, transferable, worldwide licence to host, modify, distribute and exploit user content without compensation, plus rights to use names, images and likenesses in promotion ballercam-11. The FAQ states Baller never sells user data or shares recordings without explicit permission, and users can manage, download or delete saved games at any time ballercam-05, ballercam-12. Stored hours beyond the plan allowance are governed by a fair use policy that is referenced but not published in detail ballercam-05.
Privacy and compliance
The privacy policy names Baller, Inc. at 844 E Green St, Pasadena, collects contact, profile, athletic statistics, audio-visual content and information about non-users appearing in uploaded video, and includes a US state consumer privacy supplement with no GDPR section ballercam-10. The service is described as a general audience service not directed to children under 13, and the terms say it is intended for users in the United States ballercam-10, ballercam-11. The App Store privacy label lists contact info, user IDs and usage data linked to identity and precise location unlinked ballercam-06. Facial recognition and biometric processing are not mentioned in the policy ballercam-10.
Security
Livestreams and replays are shared through private links and viewers do not need accounts ballercam-12. The privacy policy states payments are processed by third parties and that data may be transferred from the US to other countries for storage and processing ballercam-10. No security certification, encryption statement or penetration testing disclosure was found.
Pricing and TCO
The device costs $299, reduced from $349, with a 30-day return window and a one-year warranty ballercam-01, ballercam-02. Cloud storage is free for 20 hours, then $99 per year for 100 hours or $199 per year for 250 hours, with unlimited filming hours on all plans subject to fair use ballercam-02. The Club Basketball Bundle adds the 80-inch tripod at the same $299 ballercam-16. Subscriptions auto-renew annually with no prorated refunds ballercam-11. A typical family therefore pays $299 once and nothing more if they delete or download games, while a club team filming forty games a year pays $299 plus $99 to $199 per year, which is a fraction of any fixed-camera subscription ballercam-02.
Support and service
Support runs through a Zendesk help centre with more than 76 articles and a request form, and the App Store page shows support responding to reviews and resolving glitches ballercam-06, ballercam-09. Shipping is same day before 2 PM Eastern on weekdays, free within the continental US, with prepaid return labels for devices ballercam-01, ballercam-17. No SLA or phone support is published.
Company health and roadmap
Baller, Inc. trades as BallerTV, was founded in 2016 in Pasadena, and PitchBook records $64.4 million raised with the last round a Series B in September 2021 from investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, plus acquisitions of FieldVision in 2019 and NextPro in 2021 ballercam-04, ballercam-14. Alex Morgan joined as strategic investor and brand ambassador at the July 2025 launch ballercam-03. The roadmap published in January 2026 names autogenerated highlight reels, deeper stats and athlete profiles, and the September 2026 app release shipped AI Plays feedback and team RSVP tools ballercam-06, ballercam-13. Revenue and profitability are not public.
Evidence and references
The strongest evidence is Baller's own product, pricing, terms, privacy and support pages, the PR Newswire launch release and the App Store listing with 505 ratings ballercam-01, ballercam-02, ballercam-03, ballercam-06, ballercam-10, ballercam-11. Third-party evidence is limited to PitchBook's funding summary and Prep Network coverage of the launch ballercam-14, ballercam-18. No independent lab test or European review was found.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Five-star reviews praise setup ease, clear video, the desktop angle picker for teaching and the absence of per-person fees, and a coach review says the ball is tracked well in basketball ballercam-06. Two-star reviews cite bugs, multi-device sync drift, clip playback showing the wrong segment and slow uploads ballercam-07. The pattern is a happy family user base and a more frustrated power user base that runs several devices per game ballercam-06, ballercam-07.
Edge versus cloud
Tracking, cropping and encoding happen on the iPhone using on-device computer vision, and the cloud handles storage, viewing and the 180-degree interactive viewer ballercam-03, ballercam-05. The phone-side load explains the cooling fan, the 10 GB per hour storage guidance and the need for a Pro-class iPhone ballercam-01, ballercam-09. Record-only sessions work without connectivity and upload later ballercam-09.
Accessibility and languages
The app is English only, requires iOS 17 or later and supports an Apple Watch companion for scoring ballercam-06. Viewers watch in any desktop or mobile browser without an account ballercam-12. No localisation for European markets is published.
Upgrade path
The upgrade path is software, since the same shell gains features through app updates, with new model-specific iPhone adapters sold separately as phones change ballercam-01, ballercam-02. Plan upgrades move from free to $99 and $199 storage tiers and unlock RTMP and custom logos at Pro ballercam-05. There is no documented path into BallerTV's paid event streaming or into any analysis platform.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the 180-degree interactive viewer on desktop, since the ability to pick any angle after the game is the feature coaches single out ballercam-06. Test livestream stability on a venue Wi-Fi at 5 Mbps and measure upload time for a full game, since these are the two recurring complaints ballercam-07, ballercam-09. Test tracking on a full-size football pitch from the 15-foot outdoor tripod to see whether the basketball-first tracker holds up outdoors ballercam-02, ballercam-07.

Company

Ownership and funding Baller, Inc., trading as BallerTV, is a private venture-backed company founded in 2016 in Pasadena, California by co-CEOs Aaron Hawkey and Robert Angarita ballercam-03, ballercam-04. PitchBook lists $64.4 million raised across rounds, the most recent a Series B on 16 September 2021, with investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Aurum Partners, Cerity Partners Ventures, Play Time and Trybe Ventures ballercam-14. Alex Morgan joined as a strategic investor at the BallerCam launch in July 2025 ballercam-03.

Financials Not public. PitchBook lists a headcount of about 250 and no valuation ballercam-14.

Scale, company-stated More than two million youth games filmed or streamed on the BallerTV platform as of July 2025 ballercam-03. BallerCam app rated 4.9 from 505 ratings on the US App Store as of 19 September 2026 ballercam-06.
